retrieval_evaluation.note: Six hand-authored queries against fictional contract documents; does not measure legal correctness.

implemented_capabilities: Markdown and text contract ingestion with clause metadata
Lightweight title and text term-overlap reranking
Optional Sentence Transformers dense embedding retrieval
Clause-level citations and abstention when no indexed terms match
CLI, evaluator and synthetic legal test corpus
limitations: The included agreements are fictional and do not state actual legal requirements.
Default vector search is TF-IDF and lexical; optional dense embedding mode requires downloading its model.
Retrieval metrics are based on a small handcrafted query set and do not evaluate legal accuracy.
The project does not provide legal advice or assess enforceability.
